key_insight: SCoRE improves visual RAG by explicitly selecting, preserving, and consolidating only the most relevant page images before answer generation, reducing exploration noise and strengthening visual grounding.
engineering_relevance: For document AI systems, this offers a practical way to build more reliable multimodal agents that can answer questions over sparse, dispersed evidence while maintaining traceable image-to-claim links.
method: Maintains a textual ledger of only query-relevant observations plus source pointers during exploration.
Reloads referenced original images at the end and consolidates them into a logical evidence sequence for final reasoning.
Trains with filtered cold-start trajectory distillation and evidence-aware reinforcement learning to reward coverage, compactness, and correctness.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes training and optimization around evidence coverage, consolidation compactness, and answer correctness, indicating evaluation is centered on both answer quality and evidence quality.
watch_item: The approach depends on accurate source pointers and successful reloading/consolidation of original images, so retrieval or ledger errors could still propagate into the final answer.
paper_title: Navigating Sparse Evidence: Agentic Visual RAG via Explicit Context Selection and Consolidation
